title: Reversal Age Allowance: Time from Pass Earning to Refund — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a points reversal after a grooming pass is cancelled and refunded, a reversal age allowance is kept back according to the calendar days from the pass purchase's points earning to the refund.

| Calendar days from the pass purchase's earning entry to the refund date | Points kept back |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | 20 |
| more than 14, at most 30 | 10 |
| 14 or fewer | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical, earning dated 1 March).** Refund on 15 March (14 days): none. Refund on 16 March (15 days): 10. Refund on 31 March (30 days): 10. Refund on 1 April (31 days): 20.
